title: Linear Equations and Literal Equations
seo_title: Grade 10 Linear and Literal Equations Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Revise the solution of linear equations; solve literal equations (changing the subject of a formula).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 10 worksheets: linear equations with brackets and fractions and changing the subject of a formula. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Do the same to both sides.
key_sub: Subject twice: take it out as a common factor.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Expand brackets and remove fractions by multiplying both sides by the LCD.
  • Collect the unknown on one side and the numbers on the other.
  • Literal equations: treat the other letters like numbers.
  • If the subject appears twice, take it out as a common factor.

Examples

Example

Make r the subject: A = P + Prt

A − P = Prt

Answer: r = (A − P)/(Pt)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Part of a bracketMultiply every term.
One side onlyMultiply both sides by the LCD.
Dividing one termDivide the whole side.

faq.q: Can a linear equation have no solution?
faq.a: Yes, if the x terms cancel and a false statement is left.

items.q: Solve x + 42 = x + 84.
items.e: Cross-multiply: 4(x + 4) = 2(x + 8). Distribute: 4x + 16 = 2x + 16. Collect: 2x = 0, so x = 0.

items.q: Solve x2 + x6 = 8.
items.e: Multiply every term by 12 (a common denominator): 6x + 2x = 96, so 8x = 96 and x = 12.

items.q: Solve x − 94 = x − 127.
items.e: Cross-multiply: 7(x − 9) = 4(x − 12). Distribute: 7x − 63 = 4x − 48. Collect: 3x = 15, so x = 5.

items.q: Solve x3 + x5 = 8.
items.e: Multiply every term by 15 (a common denominator): 5x + 3x = 120, so 8x = 120 and x = 15.
Multiply every term by 10 to clear the decimals: 7x − 1 = x + 59. Then 6x = 60, so x = 10.
Multiply every term by 10 to clear the decimals: 11x + 22 = 7x + 34. Then 4x = 12, so x = 3.

items.q: A backpack costs R43,20 after a 8% sales tax is added. Solve x + 0,08x = 43,2 to find the price before tax.
items.e: Combine like terms: 1,08x = 43,2, so x = 43,2 ÷ 1,08 = R40.

items.q: A pair of sneakers costs R132 after a 10% sales tax is added. Solve x + 0,1x = 132 to find the price before tax.
items.e: Combine like terms: 1,1x = 132, so x = 132 ÷ 1,1 = R120.
